ITEM 1 | Mixed salad greens in a white oval bowl, leaves dark green to light green with some reddish-purple tinged edges, mostly flat broad leaves and crinkled frilly pieces, a few pale white stems visible, dry-looking with no dressing or sheen, piled loosely covering roughly 80% of the bowl's surface, leaves about 5-10 cm long, sitting in the bowl with some height above the rim line | 110

ITEM 2 | Small white pale stem pieces (sprout-like or thin stalks) scattered among the greens, crisp-looking, about 1-3 cm long, covering under 3% of the bowl surface | 4
